question: Which of the following novels is set in the background of life in New Delhi after the declaration of Emergency in the 1970’s?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Rich Like Us.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rich Like Us** is a historical and political fiction novel by** Nayantara Sahgal.**
 
• It is set in the background of life in New Delhi after the declaration of Emergency in the 1970’s.
 
• Nayantara Sahgal is an** Indian writer who writes in English.**
 
• She is a member of the** Nehru-Gandhi family.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Such a Long Journey is a **1991 novel by Rohinton Mistry.**
 
• The Heart Has its Reasons dwells on the** fine balance between love and family.**
 
• The House of Blue Mangoes narrates the story of** the Neelam Illam.**
